title: Fix Duplicate Hook Execution in Cursor
prompt: All hooks in Cursor are triggered twice - once as cursor-chat and once as claude-code. This is because Cursor automatically loads hooks from both .cursor/hooks.json and .claude/settings.json. Need to prevent duplicate execution.
summary: Fixed duplicate hook execution by preventing Claude Code hook generation when Cursor hooks exist. Modified generateClaudeCodeConfig to skip hook generation when .cursor/hooks.json exists, preventing Cursor from loading hooks from both .cursor/hooks.json and .claude/settings.json. Hooks now execute only once as cursor-chat.
